title: Laser shot synthesis parameters
description: Synthesis parameters for one deterministic sci-fi laser shot (RX / ear-candy one-shot), v0.1 (#416, D-030). STEREO: the rendered audio has shape (n, 2) (float64, columns left / right) and the WAV is a 2-channel PCM file; at stereo_width 0 both channels are identical. Only schema_version and seed are required; an omitted field takes the default named in its description. Out-of-range values are rejected, never clamped. A shot is one swept voice (pitch_start_hz to pitch_end_hz over sweep_ms along sweep_curve) of a selectable `family`, plus optional ring modulation, FM, band-passed noise, crackle, echo and stereo width. All ranges and defaults are PROPOSALS chosen for a wide space, not measured against any reference; they are placeholders until the audio-engineer measures them and the user listens. No claim is made about how any family sounds.
$comment: Contract rules. (1) Families (`family`), the 'dimensions' of D-030. They share ONE parameter space; a family changes the oscillator and how it is modulated, never which fields exist. `pew`: sine carrier. `plasma`: band-limited sawtooth carrier (harmonics below 0.45 * the internal rate only). `ion`: sine plus two inharmonic upper partials (ratios 2.003 and 3.01, relative levels 0.5 and 0.25). `rift`: two sine carriers, one sweeping pitch_start_hz to pitch_end_hz and the other pitch_end_hz to pitch_start_hz (mirror sweep), equal level. `subboom`: the sweep voice at 0.5 level plus a sine layer at one quarter of the sweep frequency with a 1.5 times longer decay, 20 Hz high-pass. `glitch`: the sweep voice with its pitch held in `glitch_steps` steps over sweep_ms (sample-and-hold) and an amplitude gate (60 % open, smooth edges) per step. `glitch_steps` has no effect in the other families (like rim f2_ratio at level2 0). (2) Sweep: instantaneous frequency f(t) = pitch_start_hz * (pitch_end_hz / pitch_start_hz) ^ (min(1, t / sweep_ms) ^ sweep_curve); sweep_curve 1 is a pure exponential glide (equal ratio per time), below 1 the pitch moves early, above 1 late. After sweep_ms the pitch holds pitch_end_hz. pitch_end_hz may be above pitch_start_hz (rising shot). Phase is the integral of f, starting at 0. (3) Envelope: linear attack_ms, then exponential decay; decay_ms is the time to fall 60 dB after the attack (same definition as kick amp_decay_ms, rim decay1_ms). The file ends with the shared 5 ms fade-out, the first sample is 0, DC is removed (Hann-shaped bump, as kick / rim). (4) Modulation. fm_amount 0 = off; otherwise the carrier phase is modulated by sin(fm_ratio * carrier phase) with peak index 6 * fm_amount radians, reduced where needed so that carrier plus sidebands stay below 0.45 * the internal rate (anti-aliasing). ring_amount 0 = off; otherwise out = (1 - ring_amount) * x + ring_amount * x * sin(2 pi ring_hz t). (5) noise_level 0 = off; otherwise white noise band-passed at noise_hz (Q 1.2), scaled to unit RMS then to noise_level, times an exponential envelope with half of decay_ms, relative to the voice at unit amplitude. crackle 0 = off; otherwise sparse random impulses (density 1500 * crackle per second, random sign), 2 kHz high-passed, times the same envelope as the noise; in `glitch` crackle additionally detunes each held step by up to +- crackle octaves. (6) variation 0 = off; otherwise pitch_start_hz, pitch_end_hz, sweep_ms and decay_ms are each multiplied by 2 ^ (0.3 * variation * u) with u in [-1, 1] drawn from the seed, then limited to the contract range of that field (a shot sequence with changing seeds varies; the stored parameters stay the requested ones). (7) Echo: echo_mix 0 = off; otherwise feedback delay line of echo_ms and echo_feedback, tap k has level echo_mix * echo_feedback^(k-1); taps that would fall below 1e-4 or past the file end are dropped; with stereo_width above 0 odd taps cross over to the other channel with weight stereo_width (ping-pong). The echo is part of the file length, nothing extends it. (8) stereo_width 0 = both channels identical. Above 0: left / right carrier frequencies differ by +- 15 cents * stereo_width (left up, right down), noise and crackle are mixed per channel as sqrt(1 - w) * common + sqrt(w) * independent, and echo ping-pong as in (7). (9) Rendering is done at twice sample_rate and decimated with a linear-phase Kaiser low-pass; drive uses the kick's anti-aliased saturation on each channel. (10) Peak ceiling: the joint peak of both channels of the QUANTISED file is at most peak_ceiling_dbfs (half an LSB of headroom, as the other categories). polarity is applied after the ceiling. (11) Determinism: same resolved parameters (including seed) give a byte-identical WAV. The seed feeds noise, crackle, variation and glitch detune (own sub-streams); with noise_level 0, crackle 0 and variation 0 the output is seed-independent. (12) Length: the file has exactly round(length_ms * sample_rate / 1000) samples per channel including offset_ms of leading silence (rounded to whole samples). A sound longer than length_ms is cut with the fade. (13) No cross-field rule: every combination of in-range values is valid. The highest carrier is 8000 Hz, so with the anti-aliasing limits of (4) and (9) no field combination needs a rejection. (14) Reject out-of-range values, never clamp. Shared field names keep the meaning of kick-params / rim-params (seed, variants, bpm, sample_rate, bit_depth, drive, polarity, offset_ms, peak_ceiling_dbfs, preset). Engine identity for sidecars: engine.name 'abeltongod-audio-engine-laser' with the laser engine's own version (sample-metadata.schema.json, D-025). The sidecar features are the existing non-pitched ones measured on the mid signal ((L + R) / 2), except peak_dbfs, which is the joint peak of both channels.

seed.description: Seeds noise, crackle, variation and glitch detune (own sub-streams). Same parameters and seed give a byte-identical WAV.

length_ms.description: File length including offset_ms. If shorter than the sound needs, it is cut off and gets a 5 ms fade-out.

pitch_end_hz.description: Carrier frequency after sweep_ms, Hz. May be above pitch_start_hz.

sweep_ms.description: Time from pitch_start_hz to pitch_end_hz, ms.

sweep_curve.description: Exponent of the sweep progress: 1 = pure exponential glide, below 1 early, above 1 late.

attack_ms.description: Linear attack, ms. 0 = the first sample after t = 0 is already at full envelope.

decay_ms.description: Time to fall 60 dB after the attack, exponential.

fm_amount.description: FM index share (peak index 6 * fm_amount rad). 0 = off.

fm_ratio.description: Modulator frequency / carrier frequency. No effect at fm_amount 0.

ring_amount.description: Mix of the ring-modulated signal. 0 = off.

ring_hz.description: Ring modulator frequency, Hz. No effect at ring_amount 0.

noise_level.description: Level of the band-passed noise relative to the voice. 0 = off.

noise_hz.description: Centre of the noise band-pass, Hz. No effect at noise_level 0.

crackle.description: Sparse impulse crackle level and density. 0 = off.

glitch_steps.description: Number of held pitch steps over sweep_ms in the glitch family. No effect in other families.

echo_mix.description: Level of the first echo tap relative to the dry shot. 0 = off.

echo_ms.description: Echo delay, ms. No effect at echo_mix 0.

echo_feedback.description: Level ratio between successive echo taps. No effect at echo_mix 0.

stereo_width.description: 0 = both channels identical; 1 = widest (see contract $comment point 8).

variation.description: Seeded random variation of pitch_start_hz, pitch_end_hz, sweep_ms and decay_ms. 0 = off (then the seed does not change the voice).

drive.description: Anti-aliased saturation, same stage as kick drive. 0 = off.

polarity.description: Sign of the whole output, applied after the peak ceiling.

offset_ms.description: Silence before the sound, rounded to whole samples (as in kick-params).

peak_ceiling_dbfs.description: Joint peak ceiling of the quantised file.

preset.description: Name of the preset these values came from, if any.
